dimension_description: This first-pass odor scale is not “how smelly” in the abstract. It is the airborne concentration of a named odorant, usually in parts per billion by volume, which makes the axis more objective and shareable. Perception still depends on chemistry and thresholds, so the named compound is part of the data, not a side note.
